notes: Focused IEEE 1516.2-2025 public-API witness. The Clause 4 simple-data-type name requirement at p. 71 l. 61 refers to §3.3.1; the §6.2.15 Create Federation Execution requirement at p. 94 l. 50 supplies the tested InconsistentFOM outcome. The valid-name control is accepted, while schema-valid variants differing only by a period, a mixed-case reserved HLA prefix, or a mixed-case reserved NA marker are rejected. This covers those three simple-data-type name boundaries only, not all HLA naming rules, arbitrary FOMs, or conformance.
